title.en: Packages, import and input with Scanner

hook.en: Java comes with thousands of tested classes: for maths, dates, input, networks. Packages keep them organised, and import lets you use them by their short names.

objectives.en: Explain what a package is and name common Java packages
Read input from the keyboard with the Scanner class

narration.en: Java comes with thousands of tested classes: for maths, dates, input, networks. Packages keep them organised, and import lets you use them by their short names.

body.en: A package is a group of related classes and interfaces, like a folder. java.lang (String, Math, wrapper classes, System) is imported automatically. Others must be imported: java.util (Scanner, ArrayList, Arrays), java.io (input and output streams). import java.util.Scanner; imports one class; import java.util.*; imports all classes of that package (not its sub-packages). You can create your own package with the package statement at the top of a file. Packages avoid name clashes and control access.
